title.rendered: Lt. Stitchie at the Mother’s Day Concert – News

content.rendered:
Lt. Stitchie

To my wonderful Patrons and all who are associated with K.K.P. I do humbly apologize for the mishap that took place during Stitchie’s performance at our recent mothers day event. Over the years we always strive for perfection in our presentation on this occasion however,  there was a mishap that could affect our perfect flow but because of the professionalism of the Artist this did not happen. Lt.Stitchie we all hope you get over this and your patrons realize that you have them in such high esteem that you are willing to perform for them even when you are going through your adversity.

content.rendered: Greetings to all my brothers and sisters. BLESSED THANKS! I want to announce the the creation of the annual event called Wonderful Vibrations that will have the biggest names in the Music industry of Roots and Culture of Reggae, Dance Hall with positive and righteous lyrics and vibrations. Every year we will have this enormous and unforgettable events. I plan to included talent contest for youth. The best DJs spinning vibrations of love. Ticket holders with children under 15, so 14 years old and younger, are admitted free to the event and up to two children per adult ticket holder. There will be food, beverages and activities throughout the entire event. Our first production will be in Jamaica 2024 – likely in June and will be announced shortly. Artists to be announced February 24, 2024. There are a limited amount of tickets available, please visit this site and register your name and the amount of tickets requested to get the advanced ticket sales. I am looking forward to seeing you all back on stage with the greatest performing artists in history. Blessed love to you all.
